The groundwater level fluctuation analysis of Pre-monsoon 2025 with decadal mean of Pre-monsoon (2015-2024) indicates that 67.7% of analysed wells are showing rise and 33.0% are showing fall in water level. Seeds and Fertilizers: For Kharif 2025, certified seed availability is 178.64 lakh quintals against a requirement of 164.05 lakh quintals, ensuring a surplus of 14.60 lakh quintals. The fertilizer supply remains stable across all products. 6. Pests & Diseases: Intensity of pests and diseases, at some fields, has been reported to be above Economic Threshold Level for Arecanut (Inflorescence Caterpillar) in Tamil Nadu and Rice (Southern Rice Black Streaked Dwarf Virus (SRBSDV)) in Haryana. The Advisory has been issued by the survey team to the farms and regular monitoring is being carried out. The overall intensity of pests and diseases remained below the Economic Threshold Level. 7. Week 2 (01 Aug – 07 August 2025): - Maximum temperatures are likely to be near normal over northwest & northeast India; above normal by 1-3°C over remaining parts of the country.

chunks.text:

chunks.heading: 5. CROP SOWING STATUS FOR KHARIF SEASON
chunks.text: Kharif Crops - Area coverage - Rice: About 245.13 lakh ha (60.8% of Normal) area coverage under Kharif Rice as compared to 216.16 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year. - Soybean: About 116.71 lakh ha (91.8 % of Normal) area coverage under Soyabean has been reported as compared to 121.38 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year. - Sugarcane: About 55.16 lakh ha area coverage under Sugarcane has been reported as compared to 54.88 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year. Cotton: About 103.15 lakh ha (79.6% of Normal) area coverage has been reported compared to 105.52 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
